hourlyBriefing.title: 整点快讯：欧洲强子对撞机证实极重粒子量子纠缠，中东地缘局势推动全球煤炭需求创新高
hourlyBriefing.lead: 本小时内，前沿基础物理取得重大实验突破，牛津大学团队与 CERN 合作证实极重且短暂粒子中存在量子纠缠；同时，地缘冲突对全球能源供需与核安全持续造成冲击，中东局势令航运受阻预期升高并推升煤炭需求至历史新高，俄方亦针对核电设施安全与建设进展发声。
keySignals: 牛津大学物理学家参与的研究证实，量子纠缠现象可在极重且寿命极短的粒子间发生，成果发表于《Physical Review Letters》。
受美以与伊朗冲突及霍尔木兹海峡航运受阻风险影响，多国加大高污染燃料使用，国际能源署（IEA）预测今年全球煤炭需求将增长1.2%至89.4亿吨新纪录。
Rosatom 首席执行官 Alexey Likhachev 指责乌克兰意图使核电站陷入危急状态，并就相关设施建设进展作出说明。

topStories.title: “涉谷黑胶酒吧”是一家无需任何AI提示词即可提供趣味音乐应用的初创公司
topStories.originalTitle: A Vinyl Bar in Shibuya is a startup offering fun music apps without any AI prompting
topStories.snippet: Former Spotify exec's company releases experimental "singles" that involves users in music making.
topStories.fullContent:
As AI rages on, new startups are creating tools for people to create music using generative AI prompts in the style of any artist they want. A Vinly Bar in Shibuya, a startup that sounds more like an indie band name, is focused on releasing a series of small apps that let you play around with sounds and vocals.

The company has raised a $5.5m pre-seed round from Mantis VC, SV Angel, Boxgroup, Quiet Capital, ERA, Common Metal, Gold House, Liquid 2 Ventures, Breakers VC, Systemic Ventures, and former Spotify chief content and advertising business officer, Dawn Ostroff, who joined the company as an advisor.

The startup is built by Máuhan M Zonoozy, who was the former head of innovation at Spotify. Prior to that, he founded a video clipping and remixing startup called Bubbl, which was acquired by Cricket Media.

Zonoozy, who left Spotify in 2024, said that he always wanted to go back to building something of his own. He thought that while streaming solved the access problem, most of the interaction with music was still around consumption.

“I think when I looked at emergent behaviors and younger audiences, like everyone’s growing up playing with culture through games, through filters, through creation tools. And I just felt like there was an opportunity to empower people to do something similar with music,” he told TechCrunch.

The startup releases these experiments like “singles” that are part of an album. The common theme between all of these apps or websites is interacting with different elements to create music or modify sound. For instance, Speed Surfer is a Chrome extension that changes the speed and filter of sound playing in your browser window.

Usersound is a website where you can create an “audio” username with each letter representing a note. Stacks is a stem player where you can create mixes by turning bars on or off in a 3×3 grid. Drops is about placing plaques in a pattern to deflect marbles falling down, which creates musical notes. Sampler is a website that turns YouTube videos into music samplers based on beats of different parts of the songs.

The company’s more ambitious product is an iOS app called bop. This lets you place musical instruments and effects in a grid to create different mixes of a base song. You can also adjust tempo and add one-time effects. Once you create these mixes, you can easily export them to TikTok or Instagram. A Vinly Bar in Shibuya is also working on a multiplayer version, which would let users remix songs with others.

Zonoozy said that it is making an informed choice not to infuse AI into every part of these apps. He is open to using AI to build these products and to make infrastructure solid, though.

“AI is obviously extraordinarily powerful, but I think we just don’t necessarily believe that the future of music is simply generation, like song generation via AI. And I think if AI starts to make that content more abundant, it actually makes taste and human perspective and interaction and participation even more important and even more valuable. And we’re just trying to make sure it doesn’t make it even rarer,” he said.

This year, the company aims to release a “musical sandbox mixer” product that would let users play around with different elements of music-making, including being able to create instruments.

topStories.fullTranslation:
随着人工智能热潮持续发酵，不少新创公司纷纷推出各种工具，让人们能够借助生成式AI提示词，以任意心仪艺术家的风格来创作音乐。而“涉谷黑胶酒吧”（A Vinyl Bar in Shibuya，原文有拼写作 A Vinly Bar in Shibuya）这家听起来更像独立乐队名字的初创公司，则专注于推出一系列轻量级应用程序，让用户能尽情摆弄声音与人声。

该公司已完成550万美元的种子轮前（pre-seed）融资，投资方包括 Mantis VC、SV Angel、Boxgroup、Quiet Capital、ERA、Common Metal、Gold House、Liquid 2 Ventures、Breakers VC、Systemic Ventures，以及前 Spotify 首席内容与广告业务官道恩·奥斯特罗夫（Dawn Ostroff），她也以顾问身份加入了该公司。

这家初创公司由前 Spotify 创新主管莫汉·M·佐努齐（Máuhan M Zonoozy）创办。在此之前，他曾创立视频剪辑与混剪初创公司 Bubbl，该公司后来被 Cricket Media 收购。

佐努齐于2024年离开 Spotify，他表示自己一直想重回自主创业的道路。他认为，虽然流媒体解决了音乐获取的门槛问题，但大部分与音乐的互动仍仅仅停留在消费层面。

他在接受 TechCrunch 采访时表示：“我认为，当我观察新兴行为和更年轻的受众时，大家都是通过游戏、滤镜、创作工具在玩转文化中成长的。我只是觉得，存在这样一个契机，可以让人们在音乐领域也能做到类似的事情。”

该初创公司像发行专辑里的“单曲”一样推出这些实验性产品。所有这些应用或网站的共同主线，都是通过与不同元素互动来创作音乐或修改声音。例如，Speed Surfer 是一款 Chrome 浏览器扩展程序，可以改变浏览器窗口中正在播放的声音的速度和滤镜效果。

Usersound 是一个网站，用户可以在上面创建一个“音频”用户名，其中每个字母代表一个音符。Stacks 是一款分轨播放器（stem player），用户可以通过在 3×3 网格中开启或关闭音轨条来制作混音。Drops 则是通过按特定模式放置薄片来弹开下落的弹珠，从而发出乐音。Sampler 则是一个能根据歌曲不同部分的节拍将 YouTube 视频转化为音乐采样器的网站。

该公司更具雄心的产品是一款名为 bop 的 iOS 应用。它允许用户在网格中放置乐器和音效，从而为一首基础歌曲制作出不同的混音版本。用户还可以调整节奏并添加一次性效果。制作好这些混音后，可以轻松导出到 TikTok 或 Instagram。“涉谷黑胶酒吧”目前还在开发多人协作版本，让用户能够与他人共同混音歌曲。

佐努齐表示，不将 AI 注入这些应用的每一个角落，是公司经过深思熟虑后做出的抉择。不过，他对使用 AI 来构建这些产品以及加固底层基础设施持开放态度。

他说：“AI 显然极其强大，但我认为我们并不一定相信音乐的未来仅仅是生成——比如通过 AI 进行歌曲生成。我认为，如果 AI 开始让这类内容变得越来越丰富过剩，那么品味、人类视角、互动以及参与实际上会变得更加重要、更具价值。而我们只是在努力确保这些特质不至于变得更加稀缺。”

今年，该公司的目标是推出一款“音乐沙盒混音器”产品，让用户能够摆弄音乐制作中的各种不同元素，包括能够自己创造乐器。

topStories.title: 30分钟内搞定航测制图
topStories.originalTitle: Finished aerial maps in under 30 minutes
topStories.fullContent:
I recently got a DJI Lito X1 and decided to see just how far I can push it. Aerial mapping sounded exciting: in a few minutes you can surpass Google Maps imagery and forever have a reference map of a place.

We need to ensure not to have the speed too high, otherwise the camera won't be able to keep up, and there will be gaps and misalignment in the finished map.

As you can see, I found 3.5 m/s at 80 m altitude to be effective. Lower altitude flights are higher resolution (obviously), but take longer. It's all trigonometry after all. The same FOV lower down sees less.

DJI doesn't make this easy. DJI Fly has no import.

Create a placeholder mission in the app by opening Waypoint Flight and adding some useless waypoints. We're not going to use them, but it is essential that we add them.

Yes, really, it means you need to take off for the sole purpose of adding these waypoints that you're not going to use, since you cannot add any waypoints while on the ground.

This will create /sdcard/Android/data/dji.go.v5/files/waypoint/<GUID>/<GUID>.kmz on the device, which, frustratingly, you can only see by connecting your device to a computer. I used adb. You'll need to find the KMZ you downloaded and replace the <GUID>.kmz already there with it. Don't change the names.

At first glance in the folder, it shouldn't look like you changed anything.

Luckily DJI has a tutorial on how to get to Waypoint Flight, but since you already added some waypoints, you should know where to go. You will note that the waypoints you added are gone, and the programmed flight path is now visible on the device.

You really only need to click start and wait. I cannot stress enough how fantastically cool this is. It will take off, fly to the first point, fly the whole route, capturing photos on the way (36 in this case), and then automatically land.

I maximised the map here since there are more interesting things to see there than on an empty field, but you might want to keep an eye on the camera just in case.

After you land, you can simply select all from today, aiming to match up the number of images with what you saw in Waypoint Flight. If you captured 36, you will want to download 36. If you did some recreational flying after your mapping, ensure you select all of the mapping photographs first.

If in doubt, download it. Each image is geotagged. We don't much care that the images were taken precisely at each point on the flight path. The tile processing server computes the map from the geographical information in each photograph, and discards images where the gimbal was not pointing exactly down. Ergo, it's fine to accidentally submit non-mapping images to the processing server - I know it's hard to juggle so many images on a mobile device.

This can be done from the phone or computer in several different ways, depending on what goes wrong (something will eventually go wrong).

To process the photographs, I'm using an on-site machine connected over Tailscale.

It then stitches the map, and the finished tiles are pulled back to the Zeitgeist Survey cloud server.

There we have it, an end-to-end demonstration of the Zeitgeist Survey capabilities. Plan to delivered map in under 30 minutes.

You can press the button below to see the live interactive map.

我最近入手了一台大疆 DJI Lito X1，并决定看看能把它推向什么极限。航空测绘听起来令人兴奋：短短几分钟内，你就能超越谷歌地图的影像质量，并永久拥有一张某个地点的参考地图。

我们需要确保飞行速度不要太快，否则相机将无法跟上，最终生成的地图中就会出现缝隙和错位。

正如你所见，我发现飞行高度 80 米、速度 3.5 米/秒的效果很好。较低高度的飞行分辨率更高（显而易见），但耗时更长。毕竟这完全是三角学原理：相同的视场角（FOV）在较低高度覆盖的范围更小。

大疆并没有让这一切变得轻松。DJI Fly 应用程序没有航线导入功能。

在应用中打开“航线飞行”（Waypoint Flight），添加几个毫无用处的航点，以此创建一个占位任务。我们不会用到这些航点，但添加它们是必不可少的。

是的，真的如此，这意味着你必须专程起飞一次，只为了添加这些你根本用不上的航点，因为你在地面上无法添加任何航点。

这会在设备上生成 /sdcard/Android/data/dji.go.v5/files/waypoint/ / .kmz 文件，令人沮丧的是，你只能通过将设备连接到电脑才能看到它。我使用了 adb。你需要找到下载好的 KMZ 文件，并用它替换掉原来在那里的 .kmz 文件。不要更改文件名。

乍看该文件夹，应该看不出你做过任何修改。

幸运的是，大疆提供了如何进入航线飞行的教程，但既然你之前已经添加过航点，你应该知道该点哪里。你会注意到之前添加的航点已经消失，预设好的航线现在已经在设备上清晰可见。

你真的只需要点击开始并等待。我简直无法形容这有多么酷炫。它会自动起飞，飞往第一个航点，飞完全程航线，一路上拍照（本例中拍摄了 36 张），然后自动降落。

我在这里把地图视图最大化了，因为那里比空旷的田野有更多有趣的东西可以看，但以防万一，你可能还是需要留意相机画面。

降落后，只需直接全选当天的照片，目标是让照片数量与在“航线飞行”中看到的一致。如果拍了 36 张，你就需要下载 36 张。如果在测绘完成后你还进行了休闲飞行，请务必先选齐所有测绘照片。

如有疑虑，全部下载即可。每张照片都带有地理标记。我们并不太在乎照片是否严格在航线的每个航点上精确拍摄。瓦片处理服务器会根据每张照片中的地理信息来计算生成地图，并丢弃云台没有垂直朝下的照片。因此，就算不小心把非测绘照片也提交给了处理服务器也没关系——我知道在移动设备上管理这么多照片确实很繁琐。

这一步可以通过手机或电脑以多种不同方式完成，具体取决于遇到了什么故障（反正迟早会出点岔子）。

为了处理这些照片，我使用了一台通过 Tailscale 连接的现场机器。

随后它会拼接地图，生成完毕的瓦片会被拉取回 Zeitgeist Survey 的云端服务器。

搞定！这就是 Zeitgeist Survey 能力的端到端演示。从规划到最终交付地图，耗时不到 30 分钟。

你可以点击下方的按钮查看实时交互式地图。

topStories.title: 物理学家助力在大型强子对撞机中揭示“幽灵般的”量子效应
topStories.originalTitle: Physicists help uncover 'spooky' quantum effect in the Large Hadron Collider
topStories.snippet: Physicists at the University of Oxford have helped confirm that one of the strangest phenomena in physics—quantum entanglement—occurs even among some of the heaviest and most fleeting particles ever created. The discovery, made using the world's most powerful particle collider at CERN, has been published in Physical Review Letters.
topStories.fullContent:
by University of Oxford

edited by Lisa Lock, reviewed by Robert Egan

This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies. Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

peer-reviewed publication

Physicists at the University of Oxford have helped confirm that one of the strangest phenomena in physics—quantum entanglement—occurs even among some of the heaviest and most fleeting particles ever created. The discovery, made using the world's most powerful particle collider at CERN, has been published in Physical Review Letters.

Entanglement is the phenomenon in which two particles from the same origin remain connected, even if they move far apart in time and space. If something affects one particle, it will also affect all the particles with which it is entangled. This means that measuring a property of one particle instantly tells you something about its entangled partners, no matter how distant they are.

Albert Einstein famously called entanglement "spooky action at a distance," and the phenomenon has been demonstrated in a range of systems, including photons, electrons and trapped ions. Today, entanglement is no longer just a curiosity: It underpins emerging technologies such as quantum computers, ultra-secure quantum communication networks and next-generation sensors. For instance, in quantum computing, entanglement is used to manipulate multiple qubits in a single operation rather than individually. This allows multiple calculations to be performed simultaneously.

However, it was unknown whether quantum entanglement remains intact under more extreme conditions—such as the short-lived particles produced during highly energetic collisions. To test this, an international collaboration used the ATLAS experiment at CERN's Large Hadron Collider (LHC) near Geneva, Switzerland. The team looked for entanglement in an entirely new setting: pairs of Z bosons that exist for only a fraction of a second before decaying.

"Quantum mechanics underpins computing, security and many areas of physics. However, quantum mechanics has mysteries and puzzles that are not yet fully understood. Using particle colliders allows us to test quantum mechanics at energies a trillion times higher and over distances smaller than the size of the nucleus. This probes some of the extreme conditions where quantum mechanics might break down, which would have profound consequences for the foundations of science," said study co-author Professor Alan Barr of the Department of Physics.

The Z bosons studied were produced in the decay of a Higgs boson—the particle discovered at the LHC in 2012—which briefly split into two Z bosons before each decayed further into pairs of electrons or muons. The Higgs bosons are generated by smashing together protons traveling at 99.99% the speed of light in collisions with energies of 13 trillion electron volts.

Although the Z bosons vanish almost instantly, the ATLAS detector can precisely track the electrons and muons they leave behind. By reconstructing the angles at which these particles were emitted, the researchers could infer the spins of the original Z bosons and test whether they were linked by quantum entanglement. The results showed strong evidence that they were. This makes it one of the highest-energy confirmations of quantum entanglement ever recorded.

Study co-author Professor Barr, at Oxford's Department of Physics, was one of the first to propose that particle colliders could be used to investigate quantum entanglement at vastly higher energy levels than all previous tests. Having been involved in the construction of the LHC, he realized that the colossal apparatus could be used for more than discovering new particles. His ideas informed a 2023 experiment, also using the ATLAS detector, which demonstrated entanglement between pairs of top quarks, the heaviest known elementary particle.

Professor Barr said, "We're used to thinking of entanglement as something delicate, seen in laboratory experiments with single photons. Finding it alive and well among particles as heavy and short-lived as Z bosons, created in some of the most violent collisions we can produce on Earth, shows just how fundamental and robust this quantum effect really is. It's a nice reminder that the same strange rules of quantum mechanics that may one day power quantum computers are at work everywhere in nature, even at the extreme energies of the Large Hadron Collider."

"It has been gratifying to see that the use of particle colliders to test quantum effects has now become a major subfield in physics, with more than a hundred researchers working on it worldwide," said study co-author Professor Barr of the Department of Physics.

Beyond its fundamental significance, the research adds to a growing effort by physicists to borrow tools and ideas from quantum information science (the field behind quantum computing) and apply them to particle physics. This cross-pollination is helping scientists develop new, more sensitive ways of analyzing collider data, with the potential to reveal subtle effects that might point to physics beyond our current understanding of the universe.

At Oxford University, Professor Barr co-leads a major interdisciplinary project exploring the foundations of quantum mechanics at high energies. Besides empirically testing quantum effects at the smallest possible scales and highest energies, the project is also investigating the philosophical implications of these measurements and what they may tell us about the fundamental nature of reality.

Project co-principal investigator Professor Chris Timpson (Faculty of Philosophy) said, "Entanglement is both the most promising and the most puzzling aspect of quantum reality; these collider experiments detecting entanglement present a new frontier in investigations of the foundations of quantum mechanics."

Oxford University researchers are also involved in the upgrade currently taking place on the ATLAS detector. Combined with the upgraded High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider, this will allow researchers to undertake even more profound explorations of quantum phenomena and apply novel quantum information techniques to exploit the huge data sets that this machine will deliver.

Professor Daniela Bortoletto (Department of Physics, University of Oxford), who is the U.K. coordinator for producing the modules for the upgraded ATLAS detector's pixel system, said, "This measurement demonstrates the scientific power of the ATLAS collaboration and the unique capabilities of CERN's Large Hadron Collider. Oxford researchers have played a leading role in developing these new approaches to studying quantum phenomena at the highest energies, and we are proud to contribute to an international effort that is opening new ways to explore the fundamental laws of nature."

G. Aad et al, Measurements of Z-Boson Pair Entanglement in Decays of Higgs Bosons at the ATLAS Experiment, Physical Review Letters (2026). DOI: 10.1103/y1nh-1b82

Journal information: Physical Review Letters

Provided by University of Oxford

topStories.fullTranslation:
来自牛津大学
由莉萨·洛克（Lisa Lock）编辑，罗伯特·伊根（Robert Egan）审阅
本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程与规范进行审核。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性：
同行评审出版物

牛津大学的物理学家助力证实，物理学中最奇特的现象之一——量子纠缠——即使在有史以来产生的某些最重且最转瞬即逝的粒子之间也依然存在。这项利用欧洲核子研究中心（CERN）全球最强大的粒子对撞机取得的发现，已发表在《物理评论快报》（Physical Review Letters）上。

量子纠缠是指同源的两个粒子即使在时空上相距遥远也能保持关联的现象。如果某种因素影响了其中一个粒子，它也会影响所有与其纠缠的粒子。这意味着测量一个粒子的某种性质，就能立即获知关于其纠缠伙伴的信息，无论它们相距多远。

阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦曾著名地将量子纠缠称为“鬼魅般的超距作用”，这一现象已在一系列系统中得到证实，包括光子、电子和俘获离子。如今，纠缠已不再仅仅是一种令人好奇的现象：它支撑着量子计算机、超安全量子通信网络和下一代传感器等新兴技术。例如，在量子计算中，纠缠被用于在单次操作中同时操控多个量子比特，而不是逐一进行。这使得多项计算可以同时执行。

然而，量子纠缠在更为极端的条件下——例如在超高能碰撞期间产生的短寿命粒子中——是否仍能保持完好，此前尚属未知。为了检验这一点，一个国际合作团队利用了位于瑞士日内瓦附近的 CERN 大型强子对撞机（LHC）上的 ATLAS 实验。该团队在一种全新的环境中寻找纠缠：仅存在几分之一秒便衰变的一对对 Z 玻色子。

该研究合著者、物理系教授艾伦·巴尔（Alan Barr）表示：“量子力学构成了计算、安全以及诸多物理学领域的基础。然而，量子力学仍有尚未被完全理解的谜团和难题。利用粒子对撞机，我们能够在高出万亿倍的能量级以及小于原子核尺寸的距离尺度上检验量子力学。这将探究量子力学可能崩溃的某些极端条件，而这会对科学的基石产生深远的影响。”

研究所涉及的 Z 玻色子是在希格斯玻色子（2012年在 LHC 上发现的粒子）的衰变过程中产生的，希格斯玻色子短暂地分裂成两个 Z 玻色子，随后每个 Z 玻色子又进一步衰变为成对的电子或缪子。希格斯玻色子是通过让以 99.99% 光速运行的质子在 13 万亿电子伏特的能量下发生对撞而产生的。

尽管 Z 玻色子几乎瞬间消失，但 ATLAS 探测器能够精确追踪它们遗留下的电子和缪子。通过重建这些粒子发射的角度，研究人员可以推断出最初 Z 玻色子的自旋，并检验它们是否通过量子纠缠关联在一起。结果显示了支持这一点的强有力证据。这使其成为有记录以来能量最高的量子纠缠证实之一。

该研究合著者、牛津大学物理系的巴尔教授是最早提出可以利用粒子对撞机在远高于以往所有测试的能级上研究量子纠缠的学者之一。巴尔曾参与 LHC 的建造，他意识到这个庞大的装置不仅能用于发现新粒子。他的构想为 2023 年同样利用 ATLAS 探测器进行的一项实验提供了依据，该实验证实了已知最重的基本粒子——顶夸克对之间的纠缠。

巴尔教授表示：“我们通常认为纠缠是一种脆弱的现象，见于单光子的实验室实验中。但在像 Z 玻色子这样重且转瞬即逝的粒子之间发现它完好存在——这些粒子产生于我们在地球上所能制造的最剧烈的碰撞中——这表明这种量子效应究竟有多么基本和稳健。这是一个很好的提醒：有朝一日可能为量子计算机提供动力的奇特量子力学规则，在自然界的任何地方都在起作用，哪怕是在大型强子对撞机的极端能量下。”

该研究合著者、物理系教授巴尔表示：“令人欣慰的是，利用粒子对撞机检验量子效应现在已经成为物理学的一个主要分支领域，全球有超过一百名研究人员正在为此工作。”

除了其基础意义之外，这项研究还加入了一项不断发展的努力之中，即物理学家借鉴量子信息科学（量子计算背后的领域）的工具和理念，并将其应用于粒子物理学。这种跨领域的交融正在帮助科学家开发全新、更灵敏的对撞机数据分析方法，有望揭示可能指向超越我们当前对宇宙理解的物理现象的微妙效应。

在牛津大学，巴尔教授共同领导着一个重大跨学科项目，探索高能条件下的量子力学基础。除了在尽可能最小的尺度和最高能量下对量子效应进行实证检验外，该项目还在探究这些测量的哲学意涵，以及它们能揭示关于现实基本本质的何种内涵。

项目共同负责人、哲学系教授克里斯·廷普森（Chris Timpson）表示：“纠缠既是量子现实中最具前景的方面，也是最令人费解的方面；这些探测纠缠的对撞机实验为量子力学基础的研究开辟了新的前沿。”

牛津大学的研究人员还参与了 ATLAS 探测器目前正在进行的升级工作。结合升级后的高亮度大型强子对撞机（High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider），这将使研究人员能够对量子现象展开更深入的探索，并应用新颖的量子信息技术来利用该装置将提供的庞大数据集。

负责英国为升级后的 ATLAS 探测器像素系统生产模块的协调人、牛津大学物理系丹妮拉·博尔托莱托（Daniela Bortoletto）教授表示：“这一测量证明了 ATLAS 合作组的科学实力以及 CERN 大型强子对撞机的独特能力。牛津大学的研究人员在开发这些于最高能量下研究量子现象的新方法中发挥了主导作用，我们为能够为这项开辟探索自然基本定律新途径的国际努力做出贡献而感到自豪。”

evidence.quote: Physicists at the University of Oxford have helped confirm that one of the strangest phenomena in physics—quantum entanglement—occurs even among some of the heaviest and most fleeting particles ever created. The discovery, made using the world's most powerful particle collider at CERN, has been published in Physical Review Letters.

To test this, an international collaboration used the ATLAS experiment at CERN's Large Hadron Collider (LHC) near Geneva, Switzerland. The team looked for entanglement in an entirely new setting: pairs of Z bosons that exist for only a fraction of a second before decaying.
The Higgs bosons are generated by smashing together protons traveling at 99.99% the speed of light in collisions with energies of 13 trillion electron volts.

Although the Z bosons vanish almost instantly, the ATLAS detector can precisely track the electrons and muons they leave behind. By reconstructing the angles at which these particles were emitted, the researchers could infer the spins of the original Z bosons and test whether they were linked by quantum entanglement. The results showed strong evidence that they were. This makes it one of the highest-energy confirmations of quantum entanglement ever recorded.
His ideas informed a 2023 experiment, also using the ATLAS detector, which demonstrated entanglement between pairs of top quarks, the heaviest known elementary particle.
G. Aad et al, Measurements of Z-Boson Pair Entanglement in Decays of Higgs Bosons at the ATLAS Experiment, Physical Review Letters (2026). DOI: 10.1103/y1nh-1b82

topStories.title: 俄罗斯国家原子能公司总经理：公司拥有处于不同完工阶段的30座RITM小型反应堆
topStories.originalTitle: Rosatom has 30 RITM small reactors at various stages of completion — CEO
topStories.snippet: Alexey Likhachev noted that 15 of them have already been built
topStories.fullContent:
VIENNA, September 14. /TASS/. Rosatom has 30 RITM small reactors at various stages of completion, with 15 already built and roughly the same number under construction, Rosatom Director General Alexey Likhachev told reporters on the sidelines of the 70th session of the IAEA General Conference.

"We currently have 30 RITM small reactors at various stages: 15 have already been built, and 13-14 are at various stages of development," the Rosatom chief said. He noted that the world is gradually realizing that Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) are not a one-size-fits-all solution, but are instead required for specific market segments.

"Small reactors -- whether in remote, isolated micro-economic systems, large-scale industrial projects, or mobile floating configurations -- are in demand within specific segments," Likhachev noted.
topStories.fullTranslation:
塔斯社维也纳9月14日电 俄罗斯国家原子能公司（Rosatom）总经理阿列克谢·利哈乔夫在国际原子能机构（IAEA）大会第70届会议期间对记者表示，该公司拥有处于不同完工阶段的30座RITM小型反应堆，其中15座已经建成，另有大致相当数量的反应堆正在建设中。

这位俄国家原子能公司负责人表示：“我们目前拥有处于不同阶段的30座RITM小型反应堆：15座已经建成，还有13至14座处于不同的研发与建设阶段。”他指出，全球正在逐渐认识到，小型模块化反应堆（SMR）并非通用型解决方案，而是特定细分市场所需要的。

利哈乔夫指出：“小型反应堆——无论是在偏远、孤立的微型经济体系、大型工业项目，还是移动式浮动平台配置中——在特定细分领域都存在需求。”

Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

See All Entertainment

See All Movie Review

Alex Gibney’s latest feature is so gigantic in scope that it might miss its intended audience.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

See All by Andrew Webster

It makes sense that Musk is a long film. The latest from Alex Gibney, who has previously directed documentaries about Theranos and Steve Jobs, is an impressively thorough retelling of the story of Elon Musk, from his early days as a dot-com millionaire to “taking a wood chipper” to vital US government departments. In order to understand Musk’s rise to power, you need to know the whole story. Musk tells it compellingly and convincingly, but doesn’t offer much in the way of revelations if you’re aware of Musk’s catastrophic influence on the world. For everyone else, a demanding runtime just shy of four hours might prove too much of a barrier to being convinced.

The film opens with shots of space and a voiceover of Musk detailing some of his sci-fi ambitions. From there, it’s a fairly chronological narrative of how we got to this point. The first section of the film reveals how Musk’s mythology was built, while also steadily seeding doubts that he’s the Tony Stark–style tycoon that many believe him to be. It starts off with the basic details, like when Musk was ousted as CEO from PayPal or how he convinced the world he founded Tesla, a company that existed before he was involved. The film juxtaposes his many bombastic claims about autonomous vehicles with visceral footage of a deadly crash involving a Tesla on autopilot. It drops in poignant interviews, like when former MAGA influencer Ashley St Clair, mother to one of Musk’s many children, declares in a terrified voice: “Elon is a nuke.”

At the outset, Gibney makes it clear that his goal is to answer two questions with interrelated answers: how Musk got so powerful, and why we allowed it to happen. By gradually accruing power through Tesla, X, SpaceX, and Starlink, Musk ingratiated himself with governments all over the world, in particular the US, and then used that political power to further his own interests once it became so hard to extricate his influence. The documentary lays out the plot clearly and concisely, all in one place.

Musk himself didn’t participate in the documentary. Instead, he sent Gibney a legal threat over it. So Gibney built in a digital doppelgänger that mouths to audio of things Musk actually said, based on a database the team created of existing clips. The avatar Musk veers into uncanny valley territory, with its overly expressive face and unsettling heavy breathing, but it’s a smart way of putting Musk’s face to his words, in a manner of speaking. And it fits well with Musk’s belief in simulation theory. Additionally, the movie uses plenty of sim and video game imagery to illustrate things throughout, like a fictional first-person shooter that depicts Musk dismantling Twitter and the US government with a chainsaw that shoots lasers. It’s over-the-top and absurd, but then again we’re here, in part, because of a kid bureaucrat named Big Balls.

In many ways, Musk is successful. It lays out how he got to power and why he was able to accrue so much of it without being stopped, which boils down to him being far too rich and ingrained by the time most people realized what was going on. Unfortunately, as someone who has followed the story over the years, I can’t say I learned much or gained new insights into the man while watching Musk.

Which makes me wonder who this film is for. Many people have already woken up to the fact that Musk is something quite different than some kind of genius inventor, but there are still plenty who only associate his name with past wins like incremental advances in reusable rockets or pre-Tesla Cybertruck vehicles. The film even interviews one fan who says he intentionally ignores the things about Musk that he doesn’t agree with. That’s exactly the kind of person who would benefit most from watching Musk lay it out all in one place.

But in a world of dwindling attention spans, four hours in a theater is a lot to ask (even if it does have a 10-minute intermission). It could miss the people who need to see it the most.

Musk is in theaters on October 16th. This review is based on a screening at the Toronto International Film Festival.

《马斯克》（Musk）是一部篇幅很长的电影，这合情合理。曾执导过有关西拉诺斯（Theranos）和史蒂夫·乔布斯（Steve Jobs）纪录片的亚历克斯·吉布尼，其最新作品对埃隆·马斯克的故事进行了令人印象深刻且极为详尽的重述，从他早年作为互联网百万富翁的岁月，一直讲到对美国关键政府部门“大刀阔斧削减”（taking a wood chipper）。为了理解马斯克如何崛起掌握大权，你需要了解整个来龙去脉。《马斯克》的讲述极具吸引力和说服力，但如果你已经知晓马斯克对世界造成的灾难性影响，这部影片并没有提供太多新揭秘。对于其他人来说，接近四个小时的高门槛片长可能会成为被其说服的过大障碍。

影片以太空镜头和马斯克详细阐述其某些科幻雄心的旁白开场。从那里开始，影片以相当连贯的时间线叙述了我们是如何走到今天这一步的。影片的第一部分揭示了马斯克的神话是如何建立起来的，同时也稳步埋下了怀疑的种子，质疑他并非许多人所认为的托尼·斯塔克式的科技大亨。它从基本细节开始，比如马斯克当年如何被赶出PayPal的CEO职位，或者他是如何让全世界相信他创立了特斯拉——而这家公司在他加入之前就已经存在。影片将他对自动驾驶汽车的诸多夸张宣称，与特斯拉在Autopilot状态下发生致命车祸的触目惊心的画面并列呈现。它还穿插了令人心酸的采访，例如前MAGA网红、马斯克众多孩子的母亲之一阿什莉·圣克莱尔（Ashley St Clair）用恐惧的声音宣称：“埃隆就是一枚核弹。”

一开篇，吉布尼就明确表示他的目标是回答两个答案相互关联的问题：马斯克是如何变得如此权势滔天的，以及我们为何允许这种情况发生。通过特斯拉、X、SpaceX和星链（Starlink）逐步积聚权力，马斯克赢得了包括美国在内的世界各地政府的青睐，随后在外界极难摆脱其影响时，利用这种政治权力来进一步谋求自身利益。这部纪录片条理清晰、简明扼要地在一处集中展示了这一全局图景。

马斯克本人没有参与这部纪录片。相反，他为此向吉布尼发出了法律威胁。因此，吉布尼根据团队建立的现有视频片段数据库，构建了一个数字替身，让其根据马斯克实际讲过的话对口型。这个虚拟马斯克由于其过于夸张的面部表情和令人不安的粗重呼吸，陷入了“恐怖谷”领域，但从某种意义上说，这是一种将马斯克的面孔与其言论结合起来的巧妙方式。而且这也非常契合马斯克对模拟理论（simulation theory）的笃信。此外，整部影片大量使用了模拟游戏和视频游戏的意象来进行阐释，比如一款虚构的第一人称射击游戏，描绘了马斯克手持发射激光的电锯拆解Twitter和美国政府的场景。这虽然夸张且荒谬，但话说回来，我们之所以走到今天，在某种程度上也是因为一个名为Big Balls的初级官僚。

在很多方面，《马斯克》是成功的。它阐明了他如何获得权力，以及为什么他能够不受阻拦地积聚如此多的权力——这归结为等到大多数人意识到发生了什么的时候，他已经太过富有且根深蒂固。不幸的是，作为多年来一直关注这一事件的人，我不能说自己在观看《马斯克》时学到了很多东西，或者对这个人获得了什么新的见解。

这让我不禁思考这部电影到底拍给谁看。许多人已经意识到马斯克绝非某种天才发明家，但仍有许多人仅将他的名字与过去的成就联系在一起，比如可重复使用火箭的渐进式进展，或者特斯拉Cybertruck问世之前的电动车产品。影片甚至采访了一位粉丝，他表示自己会刻意忽略那些他不认同的关于马斯克的事情。这类人恰恰是最能从观看《马斯克》这种一站式全面梳理中获益的群体。

但在一个注意力持续时间不断缩短的世界里，要求人们在电影院里坐上四个小时是一件要求过高的事情（即便它包含10分钟的中场休息）。它很可能会错过那些最需要看到它的人。

《马斯克》将于10月16日在影院上映。本篇影评基于多伦多国际电影节的放映版本。

evidence.quote: The latest from Alex Gibney, who has previously directed documentaries about Theranos and Steve Jobs, is an impressively thorough retelling of the story of Elon Musk, from his early days as a dot-com millionaire to “taking a wood chipper” to vital US government departments.

topStories.fullContent:
The idea that GPs are ignoring guidelines and ‘overprescribing’ doesn’t hold water. Instead, look to our social and economic crises

Dean Burnett is a doctor of neuroscience

A new NHS report has revealed the highest ever levels of antidepressant use recorded in England, with roughly one in seven people prescribed an antidepressant item in 2025-26. This has resulted in a swathe of media coverage expressing alarm over the increase, with questions about what could, or should, be done to reverse the trend.

Such a high level of antidepressant use should, of course, prompt concern and reflection. But the popular claim that has taken hold is that antidepressant use is too high because of “ overprescribing ”, as Dr John Read, a professor of clinical psychology, says in the Daily Mail. This is the idea that patients are being prescribed antidepressants when they shouldn’t be, or when better, safer alternatives are available.

Dean Burnett is a doctor of neuroscience and the author of The Idiot Brain and Emotional Ignorance

topStories.snippet: Snails carry weather records on their backs that could be used to map prehistoric cyclones, a University of Queensland study has shown. The project led by School of the Environment researchers examined the rings on the shell of a Biggenden Banded Snail (Figuladra bayensis) collected from Coalstoun Lakes National Park in southeast Queensland.
topStories.fullContent:
by University of Queensland

edited by Sadie Harley, reviewed by Robert Egan

This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies. Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

peer-reviewed publication

Snails carry weather records on their backs that could be used to map prehistoric cyclones, a University of Queensland study has shown. The project led by School of the Environment researchers examined the rings on the shell of a Biggenden Banded Snail (Figuladra bayensis) collected from Coalstoun Lakes National Park in southeast Queensland.

The paper is published in The Holocene journal.

Dr. Nicholas Patton said tiny samples of the shell taken at millimeter intervals revealed the age of the snail, when it lived and the weather during its lifetime. "We used high-resolution radiocarbon dating to determine the age of the growth bands in the shell," Patton said.

"It contained elevated levels of radiocarbon from the nuclear tests in Australia in the 1960s, meaning we could date the growth bands and reveal the snail had lived for about 4.5 years.

"Analyzing the oxygen and carbon stable isotopes of the different bands revealed insights into the rainfall the snail experienced.

"What we saw was the shell did not grow continuously during the snail's life; there were periods of rapid growth separated by periods of little or no growth."

Honorary Professor Jamie Shulmeister said the team initially expected the rapid growth phases to correspond to years with heavier rainfall, making more food available for the snail.

"But the results showed the snail was responding to extreme rainfall events rather than annual wetness," Shulmeister said.

"Because we knew when the snail lived, the growth spurts could be linked to periods immediately following cyclones in 2015 and 2017.

"Severe Tropical Cyclone Marcia and Tropical Cyclone Debbie both caused extreme rainfall within Coalstoun Lakes National Park.

"It shows that snail shells could be used to map extreme weather events during periods before modern meteorological records.

"It was surprising and quite exciting that the humble snail could be a tool to reconstruct the paths of past cyclones even in prehistoric times."

The researchers' next step is to test the approach.

"If we are able to find shells within different layers of sediment deposits, we can combine the individual shell records together to extend this information further back in time," Patton said.

Nicholas R. Patton et al, Evaluating the Biggenden Banded Snail ( Figuladra bayensis ) as a climate archive for SE Queensland, Australia, using stable isotopes and 14 C dating, The Holocene (2026). DOI: 10.1177/09596836261477272

Journal information: The Holocene

经同行评审的出版物

昆士兰大学的一项研究表明，蜗牛背上承载着天气记录，这些记录可用于绘制史前气旋图景。该项目由该校环境学院的研究人员主导，对采集自昆士兰州东南部科尔斯顿湖国家公园（Coalstoun Lakes National Park）的一只比根登条纹蜗牛（Figuladra bayensis）壳上的生长轮纹进行了检测。

该论文发表在《全新世》（The Holocene）期刊上。

尼古拉斯·帕顿博士（Dr. Nicholas Patton）表示，以毫米为间隔采集的微小贝壳样本揭示了蜗牛的年龄、生活年代以及其生命周期内的天气情况。“我们利用高分辨率放射性碳测年法测定了贝壳中生长纹的年代，”帕顿说。

“它含有来自20世纪60年代澳大利亚核试验产生的偏高水平放射性碳，这意味着我们能够对生长纹进行测年，并揭示出这只蜗牛生活了约4.5年。

“通过分析不同生长纹中的氧和碳稳定同位素，揭示了这只蜗牛所经历的降雨情况。

“我们观察到，蜗牛壳在其一生中并非持续生长；而是经历了一个个快速生长期，中间穿插着几乎不生长或完全停滞的时期。”

名誉教授杰米·舒尔迈斯特（Jamie Shulmeister）表示，研究团队最初预计快速生长阶段会对应降雨量更充沛的年份，因为降雨会为蜗牛提供更多食物。

“但结果显示，蜗牛是在对极端降雨事件作出反应，而不是年降水量，”舒尔迈斯特说。

“由于我们知道这只蜗牛生活的具体年代，其生长突增可以与2015年和2017年气旋发生后的时期直接关联。

“强热带气旋‘玛西亚’（Marcia）和热带气旋‘黛比’（Debbie）均在科尔斯顿湖国家公园引发了极端降雨。

“这表明，蜗牛壳可用于绘制现代气象记录建立之前的极端天气事件。

“令人惊讶且非常令人兴奋的是，这种不起眼的蜗牛竟能成为重现过去（乃至史前时期）气旋路径的工具。”

研究人员的下一步计划是检验该方法。

“如果我们能在不同层的沉积矿床中找到贝壳，就可以将各个贝壳的记录结合起来，将这一信息进一步延伸到更久远的历史时期，”帕顿说。

Nicholas R. Patton 等人，《利用稳定同位素和 14C 测年法评估比根登条纹蜗牛（Figuladra bayensis）作为澳大利亚昆士兰东南部的气候档案》（Evaluating the Biggenden Banded Snail (Figuladra bayensis) as a climate archive for SE Queensland, Australia, using stable isotopes and 14C dating），《全新世》（2026）。DOI: 10.1177/09596836261477272

evidence.quote: Snails carry weather records on their backs that could be used to map prehistoric cyclones, a University of Queensland study has shown. The project led by School of the Environment researchers examined the rings on the shell of a Biggenden Banded Snail (Figuladra bayensis) collected from Coalstoun Lakes National Park in southeast Queensland.
It contained elevated levels of radiocarbon from the nuclear tests in Australia in the 1960s, meaning we could date the growth bands and reveal the snail had lived for about 4.5 years.

Because we knew when the snail lived, the growth spurts could be linked to periods immediately following cyclones in 2015 and 2017. Severe Tropical Cyclone Marcia and Tropical Cyclone Debbie both caused extreme rainfall within Coalstoun Lakes National Park.

The researchers' next step is to test the approach. 'If we are able to find shells within different layers of sediment deposits, we can combine the individual shell records together to extend this information further back in time,' Patton said.

topStories.originalTitle: Touring can take musicians to isolating, anxious extremes. Access to therapy on the road is a vital support
topStories.source: The Guardian Society (卫报社会与民生)

topStories.fullContent:
I know from our early days how high-pressure road life can be. While big tours often hire therapists, grassroots acts can’t afford it. I’m pleased to back a new scheme that aims to change that

When Radiohead started touring, it was hugely exciting, but we got signed when we had been going for five or six years and had only really played in Oxford. Suddenly you’re entering a new world: the first flush of fame, being compared to everyone else, the furnace-like experience when a band takes off and a whole new routine of late nights, bad food and everything else that goes on around live music. Everything is heightened and it can be very isolating.

In 1992 we were playing small venues in a van and then suddenly in 1993 we were spending the second half of the year in the US. On our second long tour that year, everything caught up with me. I kind of withdrew into myself. Something about being in the US made me feel “impostor syndrome”. I really did feel a very long way from home. All that anxiety has to come out somewhere – for some it’s drink and drugs – but for me it came out in my playing. There was one particular show where we were opening for Tears for Fears and another band who had [Blondie’s] Clem Burke on drums. Clem was my absolute drummer hero but I just hit peak overwhelm, and my drumming went off a cliff. Every limb seemed to be going at its own speed. The kick drum became like trying to open a heavy door.
topStories.fullTranslation:
从我们早期的经历中，我深知巡演路上的生活压力有多大。虽然大型巡演通常会聘请心理治疗师，但草根艺人却无法负担这笔费用。我很高兴能支持一项旨在改变这种现状的新计划。

当电台司令（Radiohead）刚开始巡演时，那种感觉极其令人兴奋，但我们在签约前已经组建了五六年，而且实际上只在牛津演出过。突然之间，你步入了一个全新的世界：初尝成名的滋味、被拿来与所有人比较、乐队走红时那如熔炉般的体验，以及熬夜、劣质伙食和围绕现场音乐发生的一切所构成的新常态。所有感官都被放大了，而这可能会让人感到非常孤立。

1992年，我们还开着一辆厢型货车在小型场地演出，而到了1993年下半年，我们突然就来到了美国巡演。在那一年的第二次长途巡演中，一切压力都找上了门。我整个人有些封闭起来。在美国的那种环境不知怎地让我产生了“冒充者综合征”。我真切地感到自己离家极其遥远。所有这些焦虑总得找个宣泄口——对有些人来说是借酒消愁或吸毒——但对我而言，它在我的演奏中爆发了。有一次特别的演出，我们为惊惧之泪（Tears for Fears）以及另一支由[金发女郎乐队的]克莱姆·伯克（Clem Burke）担任鼓手的乐队开场暖场。克莱姆是我心目中绝对的鼓手偶像，但我当时却崩溃到了极点，我的鼓技直线下滑。四肢仿佛都在按各自的节奏乱走，踩底鼓的感觉就像是在推开一扇沉重的铁门。

topStories.originalTitle: The producer of Fleabag and Baby Reindeer's tip for finding a hit? Don't look for one
topStories.source: NPR World (美国国家公共电台官方英文)
topStories.snippet: Theatre producer Francesca Moody has a remarkable record of spotting shows that go on to have wide success. At the Edinburgh Fringe festival, she told NPR about what she looks for in a performance.
topStories.fullContent:
Francesca Moody, theatre producer on Fleabag and Baby Reindeer, at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival, summer 2025. Jeff J Mitchell/Getty Images Europe hide caption

EDINBURGH — A Shrek burlesque parody. A one man show inspired by the 2002 Hilary Duff Disney Channel original movie Cadet Kelly. An improvised hour titled David Elms Describes a Room (despite the dry name, it's actually quite entertaining).

At the Edinburgh Fringe, which wrapped up its 79th edition late last month, almost anything can be a show. And almost any show can be an audition.

This year's festival featured more than 4,200 productions, an overwhelming marketplace of comedy, theater, cabaret — and plenty that resist easy categorization. It is also an important hunting ground for producers searching for the next unlikely thing that might travel beyond Edinburgh.

Few have a better track record for spotting it early than Francesca Moody.

The 38-year-old London producer helped bring both Fleabag and Baby Reindeer to the Fringe, years before either became a global television phenomenon.

Their success has given Moody a reputation for spotting hits early. But ask her how she decides what to produce, and she doesn't want to talk much about strategy or numbers.

"I think ultimately it's all about my personal taste, because I'm a producer who is really led by their gut," Moody told NPR on a recent afternoon from a makeshift office in Edinburgh, where the Fringe was in full swing.

Trying to reverse engineer a commercial success, she said, can ruin the exact thing she's looking for.

"As soon as I deviate from that and I pick something because I think it's going to be super commercial and go straight to the West End, or because it's going to be adapted into the next TV series, it just won't be as good."

Phoebe Waller-Bridge stars opposite Andrew Scott in Fleabag. Steve Schofield/Amazon Prime Video hide caption

Phoebe Waller-Bridge stars opposite Andrew Scott in Fleabag.

To understand what Moody means by "gut," it helps to go back to Fleabag – in the days before there was much of a Fleabag to speak of.

When Moody first got involved with the project in late 2012, the writer and actress Phoebe Waller-Bridge had written roughly a page.

"We really didn't know what it was yet at all," Moody said.

Waller-Bridge had been invited to put together a short monologue as part of a storytelling night at a London theater. At the time, Moody, who was already producing another play with Waller-Bridge, asked if she could read what she had written down. She immediately became hooked.

"You know when you get that fizzy feeling when you read something that you think is really exciting, and it doesn't really matter that it's not all there yet?"

That fizzy feeling was enough for Moody to secure a venue at the Fringe.

What followed was a dizzying, anxiety-soaked six-month period in which Moody, still only 26, learned two important lessons: First, trust is invaluable to the producer-artist relationship. And second, so is a hard deadline.

A week before rehearsals, Moody stopped by Waller-Bridge's house to see how she was getting on with the script. Save for a scatter of Post-It notes laid out across the floor, the play was still not written.

Moody, who by then had gained a reputation amongst colleagues for her keep-calm-and-carry-on demeanor, reassured Waller-Bridge, then locked her in a room and told her to keep writing.

Producer Francesca Moody at the Edinburgh Fringe festival this summer. Rebecca Rosman/NPR hide caption

A colleague later found Moody hyperventilating in a closet.

"I was wondering what would happen if this play didn't get made," she said.

It did, though the final ending — at one point there were at least three alternate conclusions — was written on the train up to the festival.

The show was still rough around the edges when it arrived in Edinburgh.

Reviews were mixed — "Waller-Bridge hasn't produced a flawless piece of writing," the critic Lyn Gardner wrote in The Guardian (though she did acknowledge for all its flaws, it was "hugely distinctive").

But Moody says that lack of polish was part of the point.

"The Fringe is this place for messy, complicated, unfinished, scrappy stuff because it's those bits that you'll find the magic in," Moody says.

Moody's own relationship with the Fringe started as a compromise.

After telling her parents she wanted to become an actor, they gently suggested she try an internship on the organizational side of things — a slightly less precarious path.

She landed an internship at the Fringe, handing out flyers and moving sets around. It was her first time away from home. She says she hasn't missed a year at the Fringe since.

Years later, just out of drama school, she bumped into a friend one day at the Fringe who said he was getting into producing, and asked if she wanted to help with a project. She accepted. While the project didn't materialize into a big break, something clicked.

"I suddenly realized everything that I loved about acting, producing was actually serving that in a better way," she said. "I felt like I had way more autonomy."

Producing still kept her at the center of the creative process, but gave her a say in what got made — and how.

At 23, she put on her first show at the Fringe, a play called The Ducks, written by playwright Michael McLean. The experience catapulted Moody into not just the Fringe, but the wider London theater ecosystem, eventually leading to her big break with Fleabag in 2013.

Five years later, she launched her own company, Francesca Moody Productions.

Around the same time, a couple of friends sent her a script for Baby Reindeer, a monologue written by the Scottish actor Richard Gadd. It was based on his real life experiences with a stalker.

Richard Gadd in Baby Reindeer on Netflix. Netflix hide caption

Richard Gadd in Baby Reindeer on Netflix.

Moody started reading the script on a train from Norwich to London and became so absorbed that, when the train reached the station, she stayed in her seat to finish the final pages.

She didn't know how she was going to produce it.

But, she thought, "By hook or by crook, I'm going to do it."

In 2019, Baby Reindeer premiered at the Fringe. Five years later, it became a Netflix series — and just like Fleabag, a global hit.

The success of both shows changed things for Moody, whose name has become a stamp of approval at the Fringe.

At this year's Fringe, Moody backed three very different shows: Crybabies: The Scaring, a horror sketch comedy; Roleplay, a one-woman drama about feminism, sex and the personas we build online; and Garry Starr: Classic Penguins, a raucous hour where a nearly naked Starr, reenacts a series of Penguin Classics — almost entirely naked.

For all their differences, Moody sees a common thread in the work she backs — comedy that doesn't take itself too seriously, even when the ideas underneath it do.

Roleplay, which perhaps generated the most buzz, sold out its full run before the festival had even kicked off. India Scarlet Kolb, a creative director from London, bought her tickets two-and-a-half months in advance. After the show, in the venue's courtyard, she said Moody's name was part of the appeal.

"I wanted to kind of see what the next hit of the Fringe would be," she said.

That reputation can be a gift to the artists Moody backs. It can also come with baggage, says Hannah Reilly, the star and writer of Roleplay.

Comic Hannah Reilly in her show Roleplay, produced by Francesca Moody, at the Edinburgh Fringe in summer 2026. Mihaela Bodlovic hide caption

"This work will never be viewed in a vacuum," Reilly said. "There can definitely be some people approaching the work with arms folded a little bit, saying 'this better be better than Fleabag and Baby Reindeer combined.'"

"Guys," she added. "This is my first solo show. Can we just take it for what it is?"

But Reilly also says Moody's role goes beyond simply scouting good work. During the development of Roleplay, Reilly says she encouraged her to lean further into the darker parts of the story and take risks.

"She really wants you to make the boldest version of what's in your head," Reilly said.

And despite the reputation, not every bet pays off for Moody.

In 2023, she produced Berlusconi: A New Musical, a satirical comedy about the former Italian Prime Minister that became a commercial and critical flop.

But that, Moody says, is part of the bargain.

"I try really, really hard not to think too much about what's coming down the line," she said.

Developing a show with a future television adaptation in mind "just isn't great for storytelling."

Take Garry Starr, one of Moody's other productions, which made its New York debut earlier this month.

Garry Starr, alter ego of Australian clown Damien Warren-Smith, at a bookshop in Edinburgh this summer, where he performed his hit show at the Fringe. Colin Hattersley/Premier Comms hide caption

The premise is hardly mainstream TV material: Garry Elizabeth Starr, the alter ego of Australian clown Damien Warren-Smith, realizes that books, just like penguins, are on the brink of extinction. Thus begins the inspiration for his journey to save penguins and literature at the same time, by acting the titles of a series of Penguin Classics books in front of a live audience.

On top of that, he's naked (save for a pair of penguin flippers, a tuxedo jacket and a black top hat). To pull it all off, Starr also needs plenty of help from the audience — and, perhaps most surprisingly — they are more than willing to play along.

Moody saw the production at the Fringe two years ago, and loved it enough to sign on as a producer.

"It's completely non-political," Warren-Smith said. "It's pure escapism."

And maybe that's what Moody is really betting on. Not the next Fleabag or Baby Reindeer.

Just something strange enough — and true enough — to be worth the risk.

弗朗西丝卡·穆迪（Francesca Moody），《伦敦生活》（Fleabag）与《驯鹿宝贝》（Baby Reindeer）的戏剧制片人，摄于2025年夏天的爱丁堡边缘艺术节（Edinburgh Fringe Festival）。杰夫·J·米切尔/盖蒂图片社欧洲分社 隐藏图片说明

爱丁堡——一场《怪物史莱克》的滑稽戏仿剧。一场受2002年希拉里·达芙主演的迪士尼频道原创电影《女兵报到》（Cadet Kelly）启发而创作的独角戏。一场名为《大卫·埃尔姆斯描绘一个房间》（David Elms Describes a Room）的即兴演出（尽管名字枯燥，实际上却相当有趣）。
在爱丁堡边缘艺术节上，几乎任何形式都可以成为一场演出；而几乎任何演出，也都可以是一场试镜。该艺术节于上月末结束了第79届盛会。
今年的艺术节呈现了4200多部作品，是一个汇聚了喜剧、戏剧、歌舞表演——以及大量难以被轻易分类的作品的庞大集市。对于那些正在寻找下一个可能走出爱丁堡、带来意外之喜的爆款作品的制片人来说，这里也是一个重要的寻宝猎场。
在敏锐早期发掘爆款方面，鲜有人能比弗朗西丝卡·穆迪拥有更辉煌的战绩。
这位38岁的伦敦制片人曾助力将《伦敦生活》和《驯鹿宝贝》带上边缘艺术节的舞台，而那时距离这两部作品成为席卷全球的现象级电视剧还有数年之久。
它们的成功为穆迪赢得了及早发掘爆款的美誉。但若问她如何决定制作什么作品，她并不太想大谈策略或数字。
“我认为归根结底全在于我的个人品味，因为我是一个真正由直觉引领的制片人，”穆迪在爱丁堡边缘艺术节正如火如荼进行期间的一个下午，在一个临时办公室里对NPR如是说。
她说，试图去逆向工程一部商业成功之作，反而可能会毁掉她真正在寻找的东西。
“一旦我背离了这一点，仅因为我觉得某部作品会极具商业价值、能直接登上西区舞台，或者觉得它能被改编成下一部热门电视剧而选择了它，那它就不会那么优秀了。”
菲比·沃勒-布里奇在《伦敦生活》中与安德鲁·斯科特演对手戏。史蒂夫·斯科菲尔德/亚马逊Prime Video 隐藏图片说明
菲比·沃勒-布里奇在《伦敦生活》中与安德鲁·斯科特演对手戏。
要理解穆迪所说的“直觉”是什么意思，不妨回顾一下《伦敦生活》——在那时，这部作品甚至还谈不上真正成型。
2012年底穆迪最初参与该项目时，编剧兼演员菲比·沃勒-布里奇（Phoebe Waller-Bridge）才写了大约一页纸。
“我们当时完全不知道它究竟会是什么，”穆迪说。
沃勒-布里奇当时受邀为伦敦一家剧院的讲故事之夜准备一段简短的独白。当时正在与沃勒-布里奇合作制作另一部戏的穆迪询问能否看看她写了什么。结果她立刻被深深吸引了。
“你知道那种当你读到自认为非常令人兴奋的内容时、内心那种沸腾的感觉吗？哪怕它甚至还没完全成型也无所谓。”
那种沸腾的感觉足以让穆迪决定在边缘艺术节锁定一个场地。
随后是一段令人眩晕、充满焦虑的六个月时光。当时年仅26岁的穆迪学到了两个重要教训：首先，信任对制片人与艺术家的关系而言至关重要；其次，硬性截止日期同样不可或缺。
排练开始前一周，穆迪顺道去沃勒-布里奇家查看剧本进展。除了地板上零散铺着的一堆便利贴外，剧本根本还没写出来。
穆迪当时已经在同行中树立起了“保持冷静、继续前行”的从容形象，她安抚了沃勒-布里奇，然后把她关在一个房间里，让她继续写。
制片人弗朗西丝卡·穆迪在今年夏天的爱丁堡边缘艺术节上。丽贝卡·罗斯曼/NPR 隐藏图片说明
后来一位同事发现穆迪在壁橱里过度换气。
“我当时在想，如果这部戏做不出来该怎么办，”她说。
它最终做出来了，尽管最终的结局——期间至少有过三个备选结局——是在前往艺术节的火车上才写完的。
当这部戏抵达爱丁堡时，制作依然略显粗糙。
各方评价褒贬不一——“沃勒-布里奇拿出的并不是一部无懈可击的作品，”评论家琳·加德纳（Lyn Gardner）在《卫报》上写道（尽管她承认，虽然存在种种不足，但该剧“极为独特”）。
但穆迪表示，不够圆润精修恰恰是其意义所在。
“边缘艺术节就是一个容纳混乱、复杂、未完成、粗粝素材的地方，因为正是从那些碎片中，你才能找到魔力，”穆迪说。
穆迪自己与边缘艺术节的渊源始于一种妥协。
在她告诉父母自己想成为一名演员后，他们委婉建议她尝试做些组织管理方面的实习——这是一条稍显不那么动荡的道路。
她在边缘艺术节找到了一份实习，负责分发传单和搬运舞台道具布景。那是她第一次离家生活。她说自那以后，自己从未缺席过任何一届边缘艺术节。
数年后，刚刚从戏剧学院毕业的她有一天在边缘艺术节偶遇了一位朋友，对方说自己正打算涉足制片领域，并问她是否愿意协助一个项目。她答应了。尽管那个项目并没有让她一鸣惊人，但某种感觉被触动了。
“我突然意识到，我在表演中所热爱的一切，制片实际上以一种更好的方式满足了它，”她说。“我觉得自己拥有了多得多的自主权。”
制片工作依然让她处于创意过程的核心，但让她对制作什么以及如何制作拥有了发言权。
23岁时，她在边缘艺术节推出了自己的第一部戏，那是剧作家迈克尔·麦克莱恩（Michael McLean）创作的戏剧《鸭子》（The Ducks）。这一经历不仅让穆迪迅速打入了边缘艺术节，还让她融入了更广阔的伦敦戏剧圈生态，并最终促成了她在2013年凭借《伦敦生活》实现突破。
五年后，她创办了自己的公司——弗朗西丝卡·穆迪制作公司（Francesca Moody Productions）。
大约在同一时期，几个朋友寄给她一份《驯鹿宝贝》的剧本，这是苏格兰演员理查德·加德（Richard Gadd）写的一部独角戏，基于他遭遇跟踪狂的真实生活经历改编。
理查德·加德在奈飞（Netflix）剧集《驯鹿宝贝》中。奈飞 隐藏图片说明
理查德·加德在奈飞剧集《驯鹿宝贝》中。
穆迪在从诺维奇开往伦敦的火车上开始阅读剧本，并深深沉浸其中，以至于火车到站后，她依然坐在座位上把最后几页读完。
她当时不知道该如何制作这部剧。
但是，她心想：“想尽一切办法，我也要把这出戏做出来。”
2019年，《驯鹿宝贝》在边缘艺术节首演。五年后，它成为了一部奈飞剧集——并与《伦敦生活》一样，成为了全球大热爆款。
这两部剧的成功改变了穆迪的处境，她的名字如今在边缘艺术节已成为一种品质保证的印章。
在今年的边缘艺术节上，穆迪支持了三部截然不同的演出：恐怖素描喜剧《爱哭鬼：惊恐》（Crybabies: The Scaring）；一部探讨女权主义、性和我们在网上塑造的人设的单人剧《角色扮演》（Roleplay）；以及喧闹喧嚣的一小时演出《加里·斯塔尔：经典企鹅》（Garry Starr: Classic Penguins）——演出中几乎全裸的斯塔尔近乎赤身裸体地重新演绎了一系列企鹅经典文库作品。
尽管这些作品风格各异，穆迪在她所支持的作品中看到了一个共同点——一种不会把自己看得太严肃沉重的喜剧，即便其内核立意十分严肃深刻。

《角色扮演》（Roleplay）或许是引发讨论最多的剧目，在艺术节甚至还没开幕之前，整个演出季的门票就已销售一空。来自伦敦的创意总监因迪亚·斯嘉丽·科尔布（India Scarlet Kolb）提前两个半月就买好了票。演出结束后，在场馆的庭院里，她表示穆迪（Moody）的名号正是吸引力的一部分。
“我就是想看看本届艺穗节的下一部爆款会是什么，”她说。
这种声誉对于穆迪所支持的艺术家而言可能是一份厚礼。但《角色扮演》的主演兼编剧汉娜·赖利（Hannah Reilly）表示，这也会带来沉重的包袱。
喜剧演员汉娜·赖利在2026年夏天的爱丁堡艺穗节上表演由弗朗西斯卡·穆迪制作的剧目《角色扮演》。米哈埃拉·博德洛维奇（Mihaela Bodlovic） 隐藏图片说明
“这部作品永远不会被孤立地看待，”赖利说，“绝对会有一些人带着审视的态度来看这部作品，抱起双臂说‘这最好比《伦敦生活》和《驯鹿宝贝》加起来还要好。’”
“朋友们，”她补充道，“这是我第一部独角戏。我们能不能就事论事地看待它本身？”
但赖利也表示，穆迪的角色远不止于单纯发掘好作品。赖利透露，在《角色扮演》的创作阶段，穆迪鼓励她进一步挖掘故事中更黑暗的部分并勇于冒险。
“她真的很希望你把你脑海中最具魄力的版本做出来，”赖利说。
尽管名声在外，穆迪的每一次押注并非都能换来成功。
2023年，她制作了《贝卢斯科尼：新音乐剧》（Berlusconi: A New Musical），这是一部关于这位意大利前总理的讽刺喜剧，最终在商业和口碑上双双遭遇滑铁卢。
但穆迪表示，这也是工作代价的一部分。
“我非常非常努力地不去过多考虑未来会发生什么，”她说。
带着未来改编成电视剧的心态去开发一部戏，“对讲故事来说根本不是好事。”
以穆迪制作的另一部剧目《加里·斯塔尔》（Garry Starr）为例，该剧于本月早些时候在纽约首演。
澳大利亚小丑演员达米安·沃伦-史密斯（Damien Warren-Smith）的化身加里·斯塔尔今夏现身爱丁堡的一家书店，他在那里表演了他在艺穗节的热门剧目。科林·哈特斯利/Premier Comms 隐藏图片说明
其前提设定很难算作主流电视素材：加里·伊丽莎白·斯塔尔——澳大利亚小丑达米安·沃伦-史密斯塑造的舞台化身——意识到书籍就像企鹅一样正处于灭绝边缘。由此激发了他的灵感：通过在现场观众面前表演一系列企鹅经典丛书的书名，展开一场同时拯救企鹅和文学的旅程。
最重要的是，他全身赤裸（除了一对企鹅脚蹼、一件燕尾服外套和一顶黑色高顶礼帽）。为了完成整场演出，斯塔尔还需要观众提供大量帮助——也许最令人惊讶的是，观众们非常乐意全力配合。
穆迪两年前在艺穗节看到了这部剧，并深深喜爱上了它，随即签约担任制片人。
“这完全无关政治，”沃伦-史密斯说，“这是纯粹的逃避现实。”
或许这才是穆迪真正押注的东西。不是下一个《伦敦生活》，也不是下一个《驯鹿宝贝》。
只要它足够奇特——也足够真实——值得去冒这个险。

topStories.title: 用这些50美元以下的平价好物 让你的家在金秋更显温馨
topStories.originalTitle: Make your home cozier for fall with these upgrades under $50
topStories.snippet: Refresh your home for fall with affordable decor under $50, including cozy throw blankets, warm lighting, candle warmers, floral wreaths and more.
topStories.fullContent:
Blankets, cookware and lighting are all less than $50 at Amazon, Wayfair and Michaels. (iStock)

Fall officially arrives Sept. 22, so it's time to make your home feel a little cozier with candles, seasonal colors and warmer fabrics. Whether you want new throw blankets (up to 81% off), festive Halloween lights or fall-ready cookware to prepare your favorite fall dishes, these affordable finds make it easy to welcome autumn in your home.

Eddie Bauer reversible green throw blanket: $39.99 (41% off)Pumpkin throw pillow covers: $41.04 (25% off)Fall corduroy throw pillow covers: $11.99 (20% off)Pumpkin night light: $12.59 (10% off)

Original price: $79.97

This soft blanket is only $15. (Wayfair)

At 81% off, now's the time to buy this comfy Bedsure fleece blanket. The oversized throw is lightweight yet warm, making it the ideal choice for cool fall nights. Choose the honey gold or burgundy shades for a pop of autumn color.

Original price: $155

Add a rug to your living room that's easy to clean. (Wayfair)

The burnt orange tint in this oriental rug effortlessly brings fall into your living space. The medium pile keeps it durable for high-traffic areas, but still feels soft underfoot.

Original price: $21.99

Enjoy candle fragrance without an open flame. (Amazon)

Light candles and enjoy the scent without an open flame with a pretty candle warmer lamp. It cozies the space and gives off a pleasant glow that gently melts your candles, helping them last longer.

These flowers bring in fall colors. (Amazon)

Add these artificial flowers to any room in the house for a slight nod to the season. The bundle mixes roses, hydrangeas and seasonal greenery.

Fall-themed serving plate: $10.19 (40% off)Assorted Halloween mugs: $43.99 (21% off)Yankee Candle apple pumpkin scented candle: $19.99 (20% off)Sweet Home Collection orange cotton placemats: $17.99 (10% off)

Original price: $26.99

Use this table runner for Halloween and Thanksgiving. (Michaels)

Whether you need a new table runner for Halloween or Thanksgiving, this plaid table runner is as autumn as it gets. At 72 inches long, it fits most dining tables.

Get 12 napkins in this festive set. (Amazon)

If fall dinner parties are your bread and butter, these leaf cloth napkins tie into the seasonal look. You get 12 napkins that are 100% cotton.

A pumpkin adds a fall touch to your food. (Amazon)

Craft delicious seasonal soups in this Staub cocotte. The pumpkin shape makes for a stunning addition to your countertop or dining table, and it's oven safe up to 572 degrees.

Faux fur throw blanket: $30.99 (23% off)Farmhouse-style beside lamps: $36.99 (21% off)Orange pillowcases, set of 2: $14.99 (21% off)Prescott 100% cotton plaid pillowcases: $31.95 (16% off)

Original price: $119

Flannel sheets keep you warm on cool nights. (Wayfair)

Now that nights are growing colder, you need a set of flannel sheets. This Kathy Ireland set is $79 off right now and comes in a festive plaid pattern. You get a fitted sheet, flat sheet and pillowcases.

Original price: $29.99

Gear up for Halloween early. (T.J. Maxx)

Prepping for Halloween early? Then you need this ghost throw blanket. It's an extra-large throw made from a soft cotton blend that feels soft.

Original price: $59.99

Upgrade to a new comforter for colder weather. (Amazon)

The Bedsure comforter set comes in an assortment of fall-themed colors, from dark green to neutral browns and tans. For less than $40, you get a comforter and two pillowcases to complete the new look.

Thankful for Every Little Thing outdoor pillow: $28.49 (50% off)Orange buffalo plaid entry rug: $15.99 (20% off)Orange outdoor pillow covers: $9.99 (17% off)Artificial mums in basket: $21.59 (10% off)

Outfit your door with a seasonal wreath. (Wayfair)

With pumpkins, faux leaves and pine cones, this fall wreath gives your entryway an instant seasonal update.

Original price: $49.99

This set comes with two mats. (Amazon)

Get two doormats in one with this combo set. An orange-brown plaid undermat brings the fall aesthetic while the "Hello Pumpkin" top mat adds some humor.

Original price: $34.99

A purple glow makes your yard spooky for Halloween. (Michaels)

Usher Halloween in early with these spooky pathway lanterns. They give off a purple hue, and bats line the outside. A built-in timer keeps them on for up to six hours.

Yankee Candle sage & citrus scented candle: $19.97 (43% off)Govee smart light bulbs: $28.99 (28% off)2-in-1 ground lights, 12-pack: $29.99 (17% off)Flameless candles, set of 5: $18.80 (10% off)

Original price: $39.99

These lights automatically turn on each night. (Amazon)

Light up your outdoor space with solar string lights now that it gets dark earlier. A large solar panel keeps the lights charged, so they automatically turn on each night. Conveniently, the remote lets you switch between settings and color temperatures.

Brighten up your home or walkway. (Amazon)

Large lanterns turn an ordinary entryway or front porch into an inviting space. A top solar panel charges the batteries that power the LED candles, giving you the glow you want without an open flame.

topStories.title: 中国称AI企业高管呼吁放缓技术研发属于“制造恐慌”
topStories.originalTitle: China says AI CEOs' call for a slowdown is 'fear mongering'
topStories.stance: 国际资本与华尔街视角
topStories.source: CNBC Markets (CNBC 市场官方英文)
topStories.snippet: Chinese state media's reports of the daily press conference also noted that all groups should work together for AI openness and inclusivity.
topStories.fullContent:
BEIJING — China on Monday pushed back on calls by U.S. AI executives for companies to slow down the development of the cutting-edge technology.

"Fear mongering, confrontation, competition will just disrupt [the] process of global AI governance," Guo Jiakun, a spokesperson for China's Foreign Ministry, said on Monday, per an English translation published by Reuters.

He was responding to a question about U.S. CEOs, including Anthropic's Dario Amodei, OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk, calling for the industry to slow down because of the dangers rapid advances in the technology pose.

China's Minister of State Security, Chen Yixin, published an article on Sunday calling for the acceleration of construction of an AI security risk prevention and control system.

The field of AI has become "the main battleground for global technological competition and a new arena for strategic rivalry among major powers," the minister said, adding there was a need for "healthy and orderly" development of the technology.

AI-related stocks slumped on Monday, with SoftBank — one of the biggest investors in OpenAI — down 10% in Japan.

"Not building the technology deprives humanity of benefits or simply places AI in the hands of authoritarian powers, while building it too fast is reckless," Amodei said in an essay published on Saturday.

He noted, however, that pacing would be limited by the lead that U.S. companies have over "authoritarian regimes, chiefly the Chinese Communist Party."

"If we slow down by more than this amount, then (unpaced) CCP-associated projects will pull ahead, creating significant national security risk," Amodei said.

U.S. President Donald Trump also warned against the U.S. losing any strategic advantage in the AI arms race. During a trip to Ireland, he rejected the AI bosses' calls, saying, "Look, we're leading China in AI... and, frankly I want to keep it that way because whoever wins AI, wins."

At the weekend, President Xi Jinping said at the BRICS bloc summit in New Delhi that China will take the lead to help foster AI collaboration and development among developing countries.

Adoption of Chinese AI models is also gaining traction among Western companies as the capability have improved.

Helen Toner, executive director of the Georgetown Center for Security and Emerging Technology and former OpenAI board member, told "Squawk Box" Monday: "The best estimates tend to say China's very best models are something like six to nine months behind the very best U.S. models."

"If that means that we slow down and they just rip past us because they're pretty close behind — that's a problem," said Toner.

"It's actually not clear how much of their advancements are sort of fast following. Where if the U.S. frontier slows, perhaps China also slows somewhat."

北京——周一，中国对美国人工智能（AI）高管呼吁各企业放缓这一尖端技术研发步伐的言论进行了驳斥。

根据路透社发布的英译内容，中国外交部发言人郭家昆周一表示：“制造恐慌、对抗与恶性竞争只会扰乱全球人工智能治理进程。”

他是在回答有关多位美国首席执行官——包括Anthropic的达里奥·阿莫迪（Dario Amodei）、OpenAI的山姆·奥特曼（Sam Altman）以及埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）——因技术快速进步带来的潜在危险而呼吁行业放缓研发步伐的提问。

中国国家安全部部长陈一新周日发表文章，呼吁加快构建人工智能安全风险防控体系。

该部长表示，人工智能领域已成为“全球科技竞争的主战场和大国战略博弈的新赛场”，并补充称需要推动该技术实现“健康有序”的发展。

周一，人工智能相关股票走低，其中OpenAI的最大投资方之一日本软银集团股价下跌10%。

“不研发这项技术会剥夺人类的福祉，或者直接将人工智能拱手让给威权力量，但研发得过快又是鲁莽的，”阿莫迪在周六发表的一篇文章中表示。

不过他指出，调控研发节奏受限于美国企业相对于“以中国共产党为首的威权政权”所保持的领先幅度。

阿莫迪说：“如果我们放缓的幅度超过这一限度，那么不受节奏约束的中共相关项目就会反超，从而构成重大的国家安全风险。”

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普也警告称，美国不能在人工智能军备竞赛中失去任何战略优势。在出访爱尔兰期间，他拒绝了人工智能高管们的呼吁，并表示：“听着，我们在人工智能领域领先中国……坦白说，我想保持这种局面，因为谁赢得了人工智能，谁就赢了一切。”

上周末，国家主席习近平在新德里举行的金砖国家峰会上表示，中国将发挥引领作用，帮助促进发展中国家之间的人工智能合作与发展。

随着性能的提升，西方企业对中国人工智能模型的采用也日益受到关注。

乔治城大学安全与新兴技术中心执行主任、OpenAI前董事会成员海伦·托纳（Helen Toner）周一在接受《财经论坛》（Squawk Box）采访时表示：“最权威的预估普遍认为，中国最顶尖的模型大概落后于美国最顶尖模型六到九个月左右。”

托纳表示：“如果这意味着我们放慢脚步，而紧随其后的他们直接飞速超越我们——那可就成问题了。”

“实际上目前尚不清楚他们的进步在多大程度上属于紧密跟风。如果美国的前沿研发放缓，或许中国的步伐也会有所放慢。”

topStories.fullContent: Gulf states called off Monday's planned meeting with Iran on reopening the Strait of Hormuz the same day Yemen's Houthis fired dozens of missiles and drones at Saudi Arabia's King Khalid airbase in Khamis Mushait, calling it retaliation for more than 300 Saudi airstrikes on Yemen in five days. A Friday drone attack Riyadh blamed on Iran-backed fighters in Iraq knocked out Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline, the kingdom's only route around the blockaded strait. The 7-million-barrel-a-day line feeds the Red Sea port of Yanbu, with traders telling Reuters its closure could cut off up to 4% of global oil supply if it stays down. Yanbu has five to seven days of oil left, unnamed sources told Reuters, and at least four Asian refiners have received no word on loading schedules at a port that normally moves 4 million barrels a day. Brent rose more than 3% when markets reopened Monday; WTI traded at $104. U.S. diesel hit a new record above $6.23 a gallon, part of a run-up that has already cost U.S. drivers more than $100 billion in extra fuel spending since the war began. ING kept its fourth-quarter Brent forecast at $80, citing volumes still moving through Hormuz itself. [GooglePreferredSource] The Houthis captured Perim Island, which splits Bab al-Mandeb in two, on Friday, then deployed fighters on Greater and Lesser Hanish, 86 nautical miles north. The strait carries 12% of global trade, including 11% of maritime oil and 8 percent of LNG. Former State Department official David Schenker called simultaneous Iranian leverage over Hormuz and Bab al-Mandeb “the worst-case scenario … two of the leading energy choke points in the world.” Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met U.S. Central Command chief Admiral Brad Cooper in Jeddah on Monday after seeking American strikes on the Houthis, but Washington offered intelligence-sharing instead. U.S. President Trump said Sunday the U.S. could stay in Iran and “keep the oil,” comparing it to Venezuela and saying oil sales there had “paid for the war many times.” He repeated that gas prices would “drop like a rock” once the war ends, which he expects shortly after the midterms. By Charles Kennedy for Oilprice.com
topStories.fullTranslation: 就在也门胡塞武装向沙特阿拉伯位于海米斯穆谢特的哈立德国王空军基地发射数十枚导弹和无人机当天，海湾国家取消了原定于周一与伊朗就重新开放霍尔木兹海峡举行的会谈。胡塞武装称，这次袭击是对沙特在五天内对也门发动300多次空袭的报复。沙特利雅得将上周五发生的一起无人机袭击归咎于伊拉克境内受伊朗支持的武装人员，该袭击导致沙特阿拉伯的东西管道瘫痪，该管道是沙特绕过被封锁海峡的唯一陆上通道。这条日输送量达700万桶的管道为红海的延布港提供补给，交易商向路透社表示，如果该管道持续停运，可能导致全球石油供应减少多达4%。匿名消息人士向路透社透露，延布港目前的石油储备仅剩5至7天，且至少有四家亚洲炼油厂尚未收到该港口的装船日程通知，而该港口平时的日转运量达400万桶。周一开盘后，布伦特原油价格上涨逾3%；WTI原油交易价格达到104美元。美国柴油价格创下每加仑6.23美元以上的新高，自战争爆发以来，这一轮涨价已导致美国驾车者多支出了超过1000亿美元的燃油开支。荷兰国际集团（ING）维持其第四季度布伦特原油80美元的预测，理由是霍尔木兹海峡本身仍有部分运量在通行。[GooglePreferredSource] 胡塞武装于周五占领了将曼德海峡一分为二的佩里姆岛，随后又在以北86海里处的大哈尼什岛和小哈尼什岛部署了武装人员。曼德海峡承载着全球12%的贸易量，其中包括11%的海运原油和8%的液化天然气。前美国国务院官员戴维·申克尔（David Schenker）将伊朗同时掌控霍尔木兹海峡和曼德海峡形容为“最糟糕的局面……全球两大最重要的能源咽喉要道”。在寻求美国对胡塞武装实施打击后，沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼周一在吉达会见了美国中央司令部司令布拉德·库珀（Brad Cooper）上将，但华盛顿仅提议提供情报共享。美国总统特朗普周日表示，美国可以留在伊朗并“保留石油”，他将其与委内瑞拉相提并论，称那里的石油销售收入已经“多次抵消了战争开销”。他重申，一旦战争结束，汽油价格将“断崖式下跌”，他预计战争将在中期选举后不久结束。文/查尔斯·肯尼迪，发表于Oilprice.com

topStories.originalTitle: Chevron Expects LNG Prices To Remain High in the Short Term

topStories.fullContent: LNG prices are set to remain at elevated levels over the next few months amid the massive supply disruption from the Middle East, Chevron Australia says. “I have a hard time seeing the prices come down” in the next six months or so, Balaji Krishnamurthy, Managing Director of Chevron Australia, told Bloomberg TV in an interview on Monday. Australia’s LNG is trading at a premium in Asia now, considering the geographic proximity with the key demand center, the executive told Bloomberg on the sidelines of the Gastech conference in Bangkok, Thailand. Chevron operates two massive LNG projects in Australia Gorgon, which its 15.6 million tons in capacity is the larger one—and the largest in Australia as a whole. The other, Wheatstone, can produce 8.9 million tons of liquefied natural gas annually. The two together account for about 5% of global LNG supply. The spot Asian LNG price for October delivery into northeast Asia jumped at the end of last week to the highest level since 2022, amid the re-escalation in the Middle East that further delayed any recovery of LNG flows out of the Strait of Hormuz. Some LNG shipments are estimated to have moved out of the chokepoint in recent weeks, as carriers loaded from Qatar and the United Arab Emirates in the Persian Gulf have transferred their cargoes onto other vessels outside the Strait of Hormuz. Still, the trickle of supply is not enough to meet demand ahead of the winter heating season in Asia and Europe, which have been locked in a competition to procure alternative LNG supply since the start of the Iran war at the end of February. The lack of meaningful recovery of Middle Eastern LNG flows and the intensified race Asia-Europe for winter gas supply has pushed the average price for October delivery into northeast Asia to $26.00 per million British thermal units MMBtu on Friday, up from $25.70 per MMBtu assessed at the end of the previous week. Friday’s price was the highest spot LNG price in Asia since December 2022. By Tsvetana Paraskova for Oilprice.com
topStories.fullTranslation:
雪佛龙澳大利亚分公司（Chevron Australia）表示，受中东地区大规模供应中断影响，未来数月液化天然气（LNG）价格将保持在较高水平。“在未来六个月左右的时间里，我很难看到价格会出现回落，”雪佛龙澳大利亚董事总经理巴拉吉·克里希那穆尔蒂（Balaji Krishnamurthy）周一在接受彭博电视台（Bloomberg TV）采访时表示。该高管在泰国曼谷举行的国际天然气技术展览会（Gastech）期间对彭博社指出，考虑到与主要需求中心的地理位置相近，目前澳大利亚的LNG在亚洲市场上享有溢价交易。

雪佛龙在澳大利亚运营着两个大型LNG项目：其中高更（Gorgon）项目产能达1560万吨，是其中规模较大的一个，也是澳大利亚全境最大的LNG项目；另一个项目惠特斯通（Wheatstone）每年可生产890万吨液化天然气。这两个项目合计约占全球LNG供应总量的5%。

上周末，交付至东北亚的10月亚洲现货LNG价格飙升至2022年以来的最高水平，原因是中东局势再度升级，进一步推迟了经霍尔木兹海峡运出的LNG货流的恢复进程。据估计，近几周已有部分LNG船运驶离该咽喉要道，因为在波斯湾从卡塔尔和阿拉伯联合酋长国装运的运输船已将货物转运至霍尔木兹海峡外的其他船舶上。尽管如此，这杯水车薪的微薄供应仍不足以满足亚洲和欧洲在冬季供暖季到来前的需求；自2月底伊朗战争爆发以来，亚欧两地一直在激烈争夺替代性LNG供应。

中东LNG运输流向缺乏实质性恢复，加上亚欧争夺冬季天然气供应的竞争加剧，促使周五交付至东北亚的10月平均价格升至每百万英热单位（MMBtu）26.00美元，高于前一周末评估的每百万英热单位25.70美元。周五的价格创下了2022年12月以来亚洲现货LNG的最高水平。

（文/Tsvetana Paraskova，来自Oilprice.com）

topStories.title: NFL与中期选举助力预测市场迎来关键秋季周期
topStories.originalTitle: NFL and midterm elections set up prediction markets for a critical fall season
topStories.stance: 国际资本与华尔街视角
topStories.source: CNBC Markets (CNBC 市场官方英文)
topStories.snippet: The 2025 football season and 2024 presidential election pushed prediction markets into the prominence they enjoy today.
topStories.fullContent:
Prediction markets that rode politics and sports to new heights the past two years are betting on their convergence this autumn to drive even more adoption.

In 2024, event contract exchanges entered the mainstream with trades tied to the presidential election that year. Then, in September 2025, the start of the NFL season a year ago marked the beginning of a surge in prediction market trading volume that has yet to slow down.

Prediction markets began another NFL season on Wednesday night, when the New England Patriots and Seattle Seahawks dueled it out in a rematch of the 2026 Super Bowl. Labor Day also marked what political observers always consider the start of the midterm election campaign season.

This year, prediction markets enter the fall bigger than they've ever been, with daily notional trading volume now consistently in the billions, two dominant incumbents and a host of smaller exchanges chasing them to take some share of the market. And now the two events that separately brought prediction markets mainstream, are happening together over just a few months.

"You have a bit of a supercycle occurring right now within the prediction markets," said Robinhood's vice president and general manager for futures and prediction markets, JB Mackenzie.

Other events are in the wings this season, too, with traders showing greater interest in economic contracts linked to where a hard-to-read Federal Reserve may take interest rates next week, and Major League Baseball playoffs in full swing in October.

Prediction platforms have rushed to prepare for the fall's events. That will continue so long as the markets continue to get the majority of their volume from sports offerings, said Seni Thomas, CEO at EDGE Markets, a financial technology company working in sports betting and prediction markets.

This season could prove crucial, especially for newer platforms. "This NFL cycle is the real key, make or break" for many newer companies, Thomas said.

Kalshi experienced a record $2.3 billion in volume traded on Saturday, the first day of college football, and unveiled a feature for speculators who participated in 2025 NFL season markets to track how they performed before this season's kickoff. It has also expanded partnerships with individual sports teams ahead of the MLB playoff season.

Both platforms suffered glitches as college football play began. Polymarket's U.S. platform was down much of Saturday, and any account that experienced losses due to the outage was eventually refunded. Kalshi prematurely resolved a market on the University of Michigan game, paying traders as if the underdog Western Michigan had pulled off an upset. Later, Kalshi corrected the Michigan result and paid out accordingly.

The platforms are leaning into sports, even while battling in court with states across the country that say sports-related event contracts amount to gambling and should fall under their regulatory purview rather than the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, a Wall Street watchdog.

"We operate pursuant to the regulations of the CFTC, and we'll continue to do so, and continue to work with stakeholders to run a safe and trusted product," said Ari Borod, president of sports business development at Polymarket in August before announcing a partnership with the New York Yankees.

While the two largest prediction market platforms seek to build on their previous NFL success, others are also trying to capitalize on the same sporting events.

Rothera, a prediction market platform developed in a joint venture between Susquehanna International Group and Robinhood, is one of them. It saw volumes boom after going online in time for the FIFA World Cup over the summer.

"Rolling out all these sports, that's a big lift," CEO Thomas Chippas said. "We've only been live since the last week of May ... We're going as fast as we can, as prudently we can."

Novig, a platform that only lists sports event contracts, started an NFL marketing campaign on Wednesday with an ad featuring actress Sydney Sweeney, one of the first celebrities to work with a smaller exchange.

ProphetX, which launched in June focusing on sports-related event contracts, also has worked to get ready for the fall by revamping its consumer platform and focusing on boosting liquidity during the NFL season.

"Our revenue doubled from June to August," ProphetX co-founder and CEO Dean Sisun said in an interview. "I would love to see it four to 5x by the end of the year on a run rate basis … I really think we can do that."

While ProphetX features sports event contracts, Sisun said the platform is planning to launch midterm election-related markets too.

Robinhood is featuring Rothera's elections-related contracts to users on its brokerage.

In the lead-up to November, Kalshi has launched several tools, such as a midterm elections hub in July, giving users data about political races all across the country. For election night, it's working on an in-person event, as well as contemplating the best way for traders and viewers to see how odds across races are changing as results pour in, Kalshi's head of politics growth Benjamin Freeman said.

Unlike in 2024, when election-related event contracts weren't legal in the U.S. until a month before the presidential vote, "there's a much longer runway to plan" in 2026, said Benjamin Freeman, head of politics growth at Kalshi.

The midterms also give platforms an opportunity to remind the public that they're more than just sports, even as the majority of trading volume continues to come from those contests.

"This week it's probably going to be a lot more about NFL," Mackenzie of Robinhood said, "but I think that's what's interesting about prediction markets. It evolves based upon what people want to be trading and what's in the news cycle."

Disclosure: CNBC and Kalshi have a commercial relationship that includes customer acquisition and a minority investment.

topStories.fullTranslation:
在过去两年中凭借政治和体育赛事的推动迈上新台阶的预测市场，正寄望于今年秋季这两大领域的交汇，以带动更大规模的普及。

2024年，随着与当年总统大选挂钩的交易展开，事件合约交易所步入主流视野。随后，在2025年9月，一年前NFL赛季的开幕标志着预测市场交易量激增的开端，而这一势头至今仍未放缓。

周三晚间，随着新英格兰爱国者队与西雅图海鹰队重演2026年超级碗对决，预测市场迎来了又一个NFL赛季。同时，劳动节也标志着政治观察人士历来认定的中期选举竞选季的开始。

今年秋季，预测市场的规模超越了以往任何时期：日均名义交易量目前稳定在数十亿美元，两大处于主导地位的在位机构以及众多规模较小的交易所正紧随其后，力争抢占一部分市场份额。而如今，曾分别将预测市场推向主流的两大事件，正集中在短短几个月内同时上演。

罗宾汉（Robinhood）负责期货与预测市场的副总裁兼总经理JB·麦肯齐（JB Mackenzie）表示：“目前在预测市场领域，确实正在形成一种超级周期。”

本季还有其他事件在酝酿之中。交易员们对经济合约表现出了更浓厚的兴趣，这些合约与难以预测的美联储下周可能采取的利率走向挂钩；此外，美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）季后赛也将在10月全面打响。

各大预测平台纷纷加紧备战秋季事件。从事体育博彩和预测市场业务的金融科技公司EDGE Markets首席执行官塞尼·托马斯（Seni Thomas）表示，只要这些市场的大部分交易量仍来自体育产品，这种势头就将持续下去。

这个赛季可能对较新的平台尤为关键。托马斯指出，对许多新公司而言，“这个NFL周期是真正的关键，关乎成败”。

在大学橄榄球赛开赛的首日（周六），Kalshi的交易量达到了创纪录的23亿美元，并为参与2025年NFL赛季市场的投机者推出了一项新功能，方便其在本赛季开赛前追踪过往战绩。在MLB季后赛前夕，它还扩大了与各个体育球队的合作伙伴关系。

随着大学橄榄球比赛开打，两大平台都遭遇了技术故障。Polymarket的美国平台在周六大部分时间处于宕机状态，任何因宕机而遭受损失的账户最终都获得了退款。Kalshi则过早地对密歇根大学的比赛进行了市场结算，按照不被看好的西密歇根大学爆冷获胜的方式向交易员进行了派彩。随后，Kalshi纠正了密歇根大学的赛果，并相应重新结算派彩。

尽管这些平台正与全美各州在法庭上对簿公堂，但它们仍持续向体育领域倾斜。这些州认为体育相关事件合约等同于赌博，应属于其监管管辖范围，而非属于华尔街监管机构——美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）。

Polymarket体育业务拓展总裁阿里·博罗德（Ari Borod）在8月宣布与纽约洋基队达成合作前表示：“我们依据CFTC的法规开展运营，今后也将继续这样做，并将继续与利益相关者合作，运营一款安全且值得信赖的产品。”

在两家最大的预测市场平台力求延续此前NFL成功的同时，其他机构也试图从这些体育赛事中获利。

由萨斯奎汉纳国际集团（Susquehanna International Group）与Robinhood合资开发的预测市场平台Rothera便是其中之一。该平台赶在夏季国际足联世界杯期间上线后，交易量便迎来激增。

首席执行官托马斯·奇帕斯（Thomas Chippas）表示：“全面铺开所有这些体育项目是一项艰巨的任务。我们从5月最后一周才刚刚上线……我们正在尽可能迅速、且尽可能谨慎地推进。”

仅提供体育事件合约的平台Novig在周三发起了一场NFL营销推广活动，由女演员悉尼·斯威尼（Sydney Sweeney）出演广告，这也是首批与较小型交易所展开合作的知名人士之一。

于6月上线、主打体育相关事件合约的ProphetX也加紧为秋季做准备，对面向消费者的平台进行了重构，并致力于在NFL赛季期间提升流动性。

ProphetX联合创始人兼首席执行官迪恩·西森（Dean Sisun）在采访中表示：“我们6月至8月的收入翻了一番。按年化计算，我希望到今年年底能增长到四至五倍……我真切地认为我们能够做到这一点。”

西森表示，尽管ProphetX主打体育事件合约，但该平台也计划推出与中期选举相关的市场。

Robinhood正在其券商平台上向用户展示Rothera的选举相关合约。

在迈向11月的过程中，Kalshi推出了若干工具，例如7月上线的中期选举中心，为用户提供全美各地政治竞选的数据。Kalshi政治增长主管本杰明·弗里曼（Benjamin Freeman）表示，针对选举之夜，平台正在筹划一场线下活动，并探讨如何在选情结果不断揭晓时，让交易员和观众以最佳方式查看各项选情赔率的变化。

Kalshi政治增长主管本杰明·弗里曼表示，与2024年总统大选投票前一个月相关事件合约才在美国合法化不同，2026年“有更充足的时间进行规划”。

中期选举也为各大平台提供了一个机会，向公众证明其业务不仅局限于体育，尽管交易量的大部分依然来自体育赛事。

Robinhood的麦肯齐表示：“本周人们的关注点可能更多会集中在NFL上，但我认为这正是预测市场的有趣之处。它会根据人们想要交易的内容以及新闻周期的动态而演变。”

披露：CNBC与Kalshi存在商业合作关系，包括获客及少数股权投资。

sourceOnlyStories.originalTitle: Kiev’s attacks on Zaporozhye plant aim to create noxious conditions for staff — Likhachev
sourceOnlyStories.snippet: Kiev intends to put the plant in a critical situation, Rosatom CEO said
sourceOnlyStories.fullContent:
VIENNA, September 14. /TASS/. By attacking the Zaporozhye nuclear power station, Kiev intends to create unbearable conditions for the staff and put the plant in a critical situation, Rosatom CEO Alexey Likhachev told reporters.

"This is a common concern -- to ensure the safety of this largest nuclear facility in Europe. We may seem far away, we’re in Vienna. The distance here is about 1,400 kilometers. And even with a moderate wind, God forbid, the radioactive cloud will reach here in just over two days. This is why, of course, this is a common European concern, a task, and our main goal here is to explain what the main risks are in the ongoing escalation and intensification of attacks on the Zaporozhye plant," he said.

He reminded that in recent months, about 100 people have been injured by shelling, and nine plant workers and civilians in Energodar killed.

"Unfortunately, about 20 Energodar residents were killed in these attacks. The chief engineer, Alexander Yakovlevich, was killed. The latest events, when the Ukrainian Armed Forces struck a convoy of refuelers delivering fuel necessary for the safety of the station, I think have put everything in place. Who is doing what, and for what purpose. Almost everyone is acknowledging that this escalation, the desire to put the station and its personnel in a hopeless situation, will not achieve the intended goal," he said.

sourceOnlyStories.snippet: The East-West Pipeline in Saudi Arabia, which delivers oil to the shores of the Red Sea, has been an important workaround to the choking of tanker traffic by Iran in the Strait of Hormuz, the only exit for tankers from the Persian Gulf to the open sea.
